items.title: Draw flows with a real mouse: rect/free-form blocks, rect/free-form lots, autofill card
items.precondition: Real mouse (the embedded QA pane cannot dispatch drag/point-click gestures)
steps: 1. Home → Rect block → drag on the map → card appears
2. Pick a tier (price shown), set Rows × Cols, click Autofill
3. Try Free-form block (click points, Enter/double-click to close)
4. In a block: Rect lot / Free-form lot drawing
5. Drag a selected lot; drag the block body
items.expected: Each gesture produces the drawn geometry; autofill divides the block into R × C movable lots; drags move live and commit one undo step
items.notes: All store paths compile and the underlying machinery (planGrid/buildLots/drag sessions) is exercised by T2/T3 equivalents

items.title: Generators: ×10 / ×100 / Fill toward a direction, clipped to the block
items.precondition: A selected lot or group in a block with free space
items.expected: Copies stamp toward the direction, stop at the block edge with a note when fewer fit; selection moves to the clones; one undo per action

items.title: Shrink guard: relocate → remove → protected hard stop
items.precondition: Block view; some sold/occupied lots inside (B01 has 108)
steps: 3. Keep shrinking toward the protected rows
items.expected: Outcast lots tuck inward while room exists; unprotected leftovers are removed with a count; once protected lots would be orphaned the resize refuses with 'occupied/sold lots in the way'
items.notes: Deterministic store logic; needs visual confirmation of the relocation behaviour

items.title: Draft survives reload; publish/discard clears it
items.expected: After reload the draft is restored dirty; after Discard + reload the seeded layout returns
items.notes: localStorage save verified in code (debounced, drag-safe); left pending for an end-to-end human pass

items.title: Map pans again with a plain drag (Rev 1)
steps: 1. Drag on empty ground — the map pans
2. Shift-drag — band select; Alt-drag — subtract; L then drag — lasso
3. Drag a selected lot — it moves; drag the viewed block's body — the block moves
items.expected: Panning works everywhere the surface has no claim; selection and drag-move keep working exactly where they should
items.notes: The surface only stops propagation on claimed gestures now; the embedded QA pane cannot dispatch map drags to verify feel

items.title: Park boots empty across the whole app (Rev 2)
items.precondition: Fresh load, no saved editor draft
steps: 1. Open Map Editor, Park Map, and Dashboard
items.expected: Editor: 'No blocks yet' + draw CTA. Park Map: its empty state with 'Go to map editor'. Dashboard: ₱0 collections, nothing outstanding, inventory 0/0 · 0% open. No NaN, no crashes, no approvals/notification badges.
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: all three pages verified clean; validate:mock passes with zero lots (0 contracts/holds/interments/commissions)
items.notes: Paste getpropsie() JSON into src/mock/park-layout.ts to regenerate the demo data on the real layout — the business seeds scale to it automatically
